review_candidates.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. IT SERVICES TECHNICIAN Our IT Services team is the backbone of our operational efficiency, ensuring seamless connectivity and technical assistance for all our employees, regardless of their location. We are seeking a skilled and helpful IT specialist to join our IT services team. This role provides advanced technical guidance and service to end-users, resolves complex IT issues, and collaborates with Level 1 technicians and senior IT staff to ensure seamless technology operations. The ideal candidate is a problem-solver with strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and a commitment to delivering outstanding customer service. This is a full-time position, onsite five days a week in Palo Alto, California with occasional on-call or after-hours support. RESPONSIBILITIES: Provide second-line technical assistance for hardware, software, and network issues via phone, email, or in-person Diagnose and resolve complex technical problems, including system crashes, network connectivity issues, and software conflicts Manage and administer user accounts, permissions, and access controls in systems like Active Directory Assist with the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of hardware (desktops, laptops, servers, and peripherals) and software applications Monitor and maintain IT systems, including performing patch management, updates, and basic server administration Document and update IT service tickets with detailed resolutions and escalate unresolved issues to Level 3 experts or specialized teams Contribute to and maintain IT knowledge base articles and self-service wikis to enhance user self-sufficiency Support IT projects, such as system upgrades, migrations, or new technology rollouts Train and mentor Level 1 technicians, providing guidance on troubleshooting techniques and best practices Ensure compliance with company IT policies, security standards, and data protection protocols Provide new hire onboarding and offboarding service support BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 2+ years of experience in IT support, helpdesk, desktop support, field service, or hands-on technical role (e.g., NOC technician, systems support, IT technician) Knowledge of Windows and macOS operating systems and Microsoft Office Suite Experience with IT service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira) and ticketing systems PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a STEM field; equivalent experience considered Proficiency in troubleshooting network issues (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs) and basic server administration (Windows Server, Linux basics) Familiarity with virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V) and cloud services (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft 365) Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft Certified Professional, or ITIL) Experience with scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python) for automation tasks Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and tools (e.g., antivirus, endpoint protection) Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines under pressure Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and customer service skills Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: $39 - $49 USD per hour Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. ITAR REQUIREMENTS: To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here. SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

review_candidates.title: Senior Windows Administrator
review_candidates.description: Responsibilities Responsibilities & Qualifications Virtualization Engineering & Operations Participate in the engineering, deployment, and sustainment of VMware ESXi clusters. Collaborate with the Virtualization Team to design and implement new cluster builds as capacity or mission requirements evolve. Configure and maintain vCenter, HA, DRS, resource pools, and cluster policies. Perform host lifecycle management including patching, upgrades, and firmware coordination. Monitor system health, performance, and capacity; proactively address operational issues. Contribute to platform optimization initiatives based on operational trends and performance analysis. VMware Platform Integration (VCF-Aligned) Support and contribute to VMware platform operations aligned with VMware Cloud Foundation architecture. Participate in lifecycle activities involving integrated compute, storage, and networking layers. Evaluate operational patterns and recommend architectural improvements consistent with modern VMware platform design practices. Collaborate with enterprise teams to maintain platform scalability and integration. vSAN & Storage Architecture Design and implement vSAN storage configurations aligned to workload needs. Develop and manage storage policies (performance, redundancy, encryption). Coordinate with SAN/NAS infrastructure where applicable. Maintain storage stability, resiliency, and performance as primary objectives. VDI Engineering & Sustainment Design, deploy, and maintain VMware Horizon environments. Build and manage desktop pools and associated infrastructure. Troubleshoot authentication, profile, and performance issues. Support secure remote access configurations (e.g., UAG) in coordination with cybersecurity and networking teams. Optimize VDI performance for mission users. Windows Server Administration (Operational Focus) Administer Windows Server infrastructure supporting virtual workloads. Manage Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy. Support smartcard/CAC authentication integration. Perform patching, vulnerability remediation, and STIG hardening. Support core infrastructure services and clustering as required. Security, Compliance & Documentation Support RMF/ATO documentation and sustainment activities. Implement and validate STIGs and vulnerability remediation efforts. Develop and maintain engineering artifacts including architecture diagrams, configuration baselines, and implementation documentation. Participate in configuration management and change control processes. Operational Support & Collaboration Provide Tier III escalation support for virtualization-related issues. Coordinate maintenance windows with stakeholders to minimize mission impact. Support backup validation, disaster recovery exercises, and continuity planning efforts. Collaborate with enterprise teams to ensure interoperability and compliance across supported environments. Required Qualifications Ability to acquire and maintain a DoD Secret clearance. Ability to acquire and maintain a DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (Security+ CE or equivalent). 5+ years of experience in enterprise virtualization or systems engineering roles. Hands-on experience building and managing multi-host VMware ESXi clusters in production environments. Strong experience with: VMware vSphere (7.x or newer) vCenter administration vSAN configuration and management VMware Horizon VDI Experience participating in cluster design and expansion, not solely administering prebuilt environments. Solid Windows Server administration experience including: Active Directory DNS DHCP Group Policy Experience supporting Linux server environments. Experience performing lifecycle management (patching, upgrades, version transitions) in production systems. Strong troubleshooting skills across compute, storage, and networking layers. Desired Qualifications VMware Certified Professional (VCP-DCV) or equivalent practical experience. Experience supporting or contributing to VMware Cloud Foundation environments. Familiarity with SDDC Manager concepts and NSX-T integration. Experience designing or optimizing vSAN storage architectures. Experience with PowerCLI, scripting, or automation. Experience supporting classified DoD networks. Experience with GPU-enabled VDI environments. A hands-on virtualization engineer with experience in production environments. A professional who understands that operational stability and engineering improvement go hand-in-hand. Someone comfortable collaborating within a team while taking ownership of their area of responsibility. An engineer who sees opportunities to improve the platform and has the technical depth to implement those improvements correctly. Overview We are seeking a Senior Windows Administrator to provide technical support for our customer AFRL (Air Force Research Laboratory), in Albuquerque, NM. The PRS of the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) is the United States Air Force's (USAF) focal point for directed energy and space and missile related research and technology. PRS is comprised of two technical directorates of the AFRL: Space Vehicles Directorate (RV) and Directed Energy Directorate (RD). The PRS Chief Information Officer (CIO) provides information technology support for these two directorates. This includes operation of a widespread and heterogeneous computing environment to include Windows/Unix/Linux servers; Windows based personal computers of various manufacture, and Windows and UNIX/Linux-based workstations connected by a Local Area Network (LAN), USAF mobile devices such as laptops, tablets and iOS devices. The PRS CIO is responsible for providing computing resources, information technology, web-based applications development, integration, and support services to the RV and RD Directorates. The objective of this requirement is to provide comprehensive information technology services. Included in this objective is the integration and maintenance of PRS communications/computer systems in compliance with defense information infrastructure instructions, standards, and architectures.
